title: IEC 61800-9-2:2023 — Energy efficiency determination and classification of power drive systems
version: IEC 61800-9-2:2023, Edition 2.0; AMD1:2025 consolidated version shown by IEC
locator: IEC official catalogue scope: loss determination and IE/IES classification for CDM, SDM, PDS and motor systems; methodology depends on system architecture and speed/torque operating profile.
notes: 标准全文未下载/归档。用于驱动系统能效评估，不可直接等同于机床切削工况下整机能耗或主轴热性能验收。
